overview: Two carbonyl-containing functional groups that differ in exactly where the carbonyl group sits within the carbon chain.
genZNote: Same carbonyl group, different neighborhood — end of the chain vs. somewhere in the middle.

aspects.label: Structure
aspects.valueA: Carbonyl group (C=O) at the END of the carbon chain, bonded to at least one hydrogen (–CHO).
aspects.valueB: Carbonyl group (C=O) bonded to two carbon-containing groups, located WITHIN the carbon chain.

aspects.label: Oxidation Behavior
aspects.valueB: Resistant to further oxidation under normal conditions (requires breaking a C-C bond).

aspects.label: Distinguishing Test
aspects.valueA: Positive Tollens' test (silver mirror) and Fehling's test.
aspects.valueB: Negative Tollens' and Fehling's tests (with rare exceptions like alpha-hydroxy ketones).
